heading: INT. DEEP-SEA HABITAT "ABYSSAL FIVE," COMMAND CABIN - NIGHT

units.text: INT. DEEP-SEA HABITAT "ABYSSAL FIVE," COMMAND CABIN - NIGHT
A cramped steel cylinder lined with gauges.
A single porthole shows blackness lit by the drifting glow of jellyfish.
A radio crackles on a bracket over the main console.
CAPTAIN OKONJO ADEYEMI, fifties, sits at the console with his hand hovering over a red switch.
BIRGIT SOLBERG, thirties, the geologist, floats against a bulkhead, her face lit green by a monitor.
RAVI NAIR, twenties, the comms tech, kneels by an open panel with a soldering iron.
How long until the pressure seal gives?
units.name: OKONJO

units.text: Nine minutes. Maybe ten.
units.name: BIRGIT

units.text: I can reroute the main to the secondary.
units.name: RAVI

units.text: Then do it.
units.name: OKONJO

units.text: He sparks the iron and hunches.
She watches the gauge.
The radio hisses.
Abyssal Five, this is Surface Control. Do you read?
units.name: SURFACE

units.text: Okonjo grabs the mic.
Surface, Okonjo. We read you.
units.name: OKONJO

units.text: Captain, we are seeing a pressure anomaly on your hull. Advise.
units.name: SURFACE

units.text: We know. We're working it.
units.name: OKONJO

units.text: Recommend immediate ascent.
units.name: SURFACE

units.text: Ascent? That's three hours of decompression.
units.name: BIRGIT

units.text: Surface, negative on ascent. We're working it.
units.name: OKONJO

units.text: The hull groans.
A rivet pops and rolls across the deck, ringing.
Ravi's iron hovers over the circuit board.
Almost. Almost.
units.name: RAVI

units.text: He touches the iron down.
A bright blue arc snaps.
The lights flicker, hold, and steady.
The groaning stops.
The gauge needle sinks slowly out of the red.
It's holding.
units.name: BIRGIT

units.text: Abyssal Five, do you copy? We show pressure normalizing.
units.name: SURFACE

units.text: Okonjo lets out a breath so long it fogs the glass of a dial.
Ravi sits back on his heels and laughs, high and cracked.
Birgit presses a palm to the bulkhead and shuts her eyes.
Surface, Abyssal Five. We copy. Stand by.
units.name: OKONJO

units.text: He releases the key.
The radio hisses.
Silence fills the cabin, filled only by the soft tick of cooling metal.
